hints.title: Symmetric Half Character Count
hints.text: Any valid symmetric word is determined by the first half of its characters and an optional middle character.

hints.title: Ascending Alphabetical Prefix
hints.text: Sort the characters allocated to the left half in lexicographically increasing order.

hints.title: Mirror Construction
hints.text: Concatenate the sorted left half, the odd-frequency middle character if present, and the reversed left half.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
import string

class Solution:
    def smallestPalindrome(self, s: str) -> str:
        cnt = Counter(s)
        half = []
        mid = ""
        for ch in string.ascii_lowercase:
            v = cnt[ch] // 2
            if v > 0:
                half.append(ch * v)
            if cnt[ch] % 2 == 1:
                mid = ch
        left = "".join(half)
        return left + mid + left[::-1]
```

complexity.notes: Alphabetical frequency enumeration constructs the minimal half in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations is factorial in complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency table uses constant 26 alphabet buckets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize symmetry and construct the minimal half greedily.
